title: Billing and Coding: Autonomic Function Tests

codes.1: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes : 95921, 95922, 95923, and 95924.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the "ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity " section of this article.
